coaches.intro.text: Set the age range each coach can coach and see their weekly availability. A team's age in a season is the season's start year minus its birth years. Changing qualifications or availability never changes plans or events by itself.

coaches.intro_coach.text: Your qualification is set by the group's admins and managers. Mark the times you are available in each season part; other coaches do not see them.

coaches.empty.text: No member has the coach role yet. Give members the coach role on the Members page.

coaches.ages_none.text: Team ages need a season. An admin or manager creates seasons on the Seasons page.

coaches.error.invalid_qualification.text: Enter whole ages from 0 to 99, the first not above the second.

coaches.availability.intro.text: Click an empty slot to add two hours, drag a window to move it, and drag its bottom edge to change its end. Overlapping or touching windows are merged. Changing availability does not change plans or events.

coaches.availability.overview_intro.text: Read only. Each coach has a color; open a coach to edit their windows.

coaches.availability.overview_empty.text: No coach has marked availability in this part.

coaches.availability.no_parts.text: There are no season parts yet. An admin or manager creates seasons on the Seasons page.

coaches.availability.windows_empty.text: No availability marked in this part yet.

coaches.availability.not_counted.text: Not counted: the part no longer has A/B weeks.

coaches.availability.copy_help.text: Replaces the windows of this part with those of {source}. Into a part without A/B weeks only every-week windows are copied.

coaches.availability.copy_confirm.text: Replace the windows of this part with those of the previous part?

coaches.availability.copied.text: Availability copied from the previous part.

coaches.availability.no_previous.text: This is the group's first season part; there is nothing to copy.

coaches.availability.error.invalid.text: That change does not fit the grid.

coaches.availability.error.week.text: Week A and B windows need a part with alternating weeks.

coaches.availability.error.not_found.text: That window no longer exists. The grid shows the current windows.

coaches.availability.error.too_many.text: A coach can have at most 100 windows per part.

coaches.availability.error.nothing_to_co.text: The previous part has no windows to copy; nothing changed.
